learn-practice.title: Practice quizzes
learn-practice.purpose: Open practice quizzes on public topics for students and applicants.

learn-practice-quiz.title: Practice quiz
learn-practice-quiz.purpose: Take a practice quiz with instant explanations.

my-assessments.title: My assessments
my-assessments.purpose: Scheduled exams, practice checks and results released to me.

training-jpm.title: JPM evaluator
training-jpm.purpose: Record JPMs and task evaluations; a failed critical step fails the JPM; self-sign is refused.

training-items.title: Item bank
training-items.purpose: Secure item bank with metadata, versions and separation of duties (writer, reviewer, approver).

training-assessments.title: Exams and proctoring
training-assessments.purpose: Exam assembly from blueprints, proctor console, item analysis and appeals.

practice.intro: Short quizzes on public nuclear topics. Check your understanding with an explanation after every question.
practice.privacy: Practice scores stay in this browser. Nothing is sent to your manager or recorded on your transcript.
practice.secure: Qualifying exams use a separate secure bank that is never shown here. Practice questions cover public, educational content only.

quiz.badge: You scored 80% or more on this topic.
quiz.rule2: About {n} minutes. There is no time limit.
quiz.rule3: Check each answer to see the explanation before moving on.

exam.confirmBody: You cannot change answers after submitting.
exam.confirmUnanswered: {n} questions are unanswered and will be scored as incorrect. You cannot change answers after submitting.
exam.rule: Answers save as you go. The exam submits itself when time runs out. Results are released by the proctor after review, not shown immediately.
exam.submittedBody: You answered {n} of {total} questions. Your result appears under Results once the proctor releases it.

my.appealBody: Explain what you believe was marked wrongly. A training manager who did not proctor this exam decides. Appeals close on {date}.
my.awaitingNote: A proctor reviews each result before it is released to you.
my.feedbackNoteTitle: Why you do not see the questions
my.feedbackNote: Secure exam questions are reused, so feedback is given by competency, not by question.
my.intro: Exams scheduled for you, results released to you, job performance measures and appeals.
my.noAppealsBody: You can appeal a released result within the appeal window.
my.noJpm: No job performance measures recorded yet.
my.noResultsBody: Results appear here after the proctor releases them.
my.noneScheduledBody: Your training team schedules qualifying exams. Practice quizzes are open any time.
my.performanceNote: Performance evaluations are run in person by a qualified evaluator.
my.question: Question
my.questionHint: Leave blank to appeal the exam as a whole.
my.resultsNote: Retake rules: wait days and the attempt limit are set per exam. A pass closes further attempts.
my.startBody: The {min}-minute timer starts now and cannot be paused.

retake.result_pending: A previous attempt has not been released yet
retake.already_passed: Already passed. No further attempts are needed.
retake.retake_limit: Attempt limit reached. The training manager must agree a remediation plan.

jpm.calibrationBody: Compare pass rates and critical-step failures across evaluators to spot drift. Small groups are suppressed.
jpm.calibrationNote: Evaluators with fewer than 10 evaluations are not shown.
jpm.confirmBody: {name}: {result} with {score}. The record is signed with your name and cannot be edited afterwards.
jpm.criticalFailedSub: A failed critical step fails the JPM
jpm.criticalRule: A failed critical step fails the whole JPM regardless of the overall score.
jpm.intro: Record job performance measures and task evaluations step by step. A failed critical step fails the JPM and self-sign is refused.
jpm.noRecord: No evaluation recorded for this candidate yet.
jpm.notesHint: Observed behaviour only. Never record plant-security detail.
jpm.offlineHint: Evaluations are queued on this device and synced when you reconnect.
jpm.pickBody: Choose a qualification standard and JPM to start an evaluation.
jpm.queuedBody: They are stored on this device only until synced.
jpm.signoffBody: You confirm {name} performed this task to standard. Your sign-off is recorded in the audit log.
jpm.signoffNote: Sign-off must come from a qualified evaluator other than the candidate.
jpm.suppressed: {n} evaluators have fewer than {min} evaluations, so their rates are not shown.
jpm.allSuppressed: No evaluator has enough evaluations to show rates yet.

items.intro: Secure exam items with metadata, versions and separation of duties: one person writes, another reviews, a training manager approves.
items.makerChecker: You wrote this item, so you cannot approve it.
items.optionsRequired: At least two options and a key are required.
items.referenceHint: Training material reference, for example a lesson plan code. No procedure text.
items.security: Secure item text and keys are never exported, logged or sent to the assistant. Exports contain metadata only.
items.versionNote: The new version returns to draft and must be reviewed and approved again. Earlier versions stay in the history.
items.submitBody: Another instructor reviews the item. You cannot edit it while it is in review.
items.reviewBody: You confirm the item is technically correct and the key is right. A training manager then approves it.
items.approveBody: The item can be drawn into secure exam forms.
items.retireBody: The item is no longer drawn into new exam forms. Past attempts keep their scoring.

exams.analysisNote: p is the share of candidates answering correctly; D compares the top and bottom 27%. Item text is never shown here.
exams.appealsReadOnly: Only a training manager who did not proctor or release the attempt can decide an appeal.
exams.approveFormBody: The form can then be scheduled for candidates.
exams.intro: Assemble exam forms from blueprints, schedule candidates, proctor attempts, release results, analyse items and decide appeals.
exams.noAttempts: No graded attempts for this exam yet.
exams.pickForm: Pick an exam to see its retake rules.
exams.releaseBody: {name} will see {score} ({result}). A pass issues the qualification evidence and certificate.
exams.rejectedBody: The score stands. The candidate sees your note.
exams.retireFormBody: It can no longer be scheduled. Past attempts are kept.
exams.rulesBody: Up to {max} attempts, {wait} days between attempts, {appeal} days to appeal, pass mark {pass}.
exams.scheduleBody: {name} is scheduled for {exam} on {when}. The exam opens on the day.
exams.short: Some competencies have fewer approved items than the blueprint needs. The draft will be shorter until more items are approved.
exams.signoffBody: Scores are computed automatically, but no result reaches the candidate until a proctor other than the candidate releases it.
exams.toReleaseSub: Graded, not yet visible to the candidate
exams.upheldBody: {n} items are voided and the attempt is rescored. If it now passes, the qualification evidence is issued.
exams.voidHint: Voided items are removed from the score for this attempt only.
